settings.name: Units of the plots
settings.description: Choose the unit in which the time lags and the median time lag are displayed in the histograms and violin plots. This setting only affects the plots: the columns 'timelag' (event data) and 'median_timelag' (track data) added to the output data are always in seconds.

settings.name: Maximum time lag shown in the plots
settings.description: Optional. Maximum time lag, in the unit selected in 'Units of the plots'. Time lags above this value are not shown in the histograms and violin plots, so that a few long gaps do not hide the distribution of the frequent, shorter time lags. These time lags are NOT removed from the data: the columns 'timelag' and 'median_timelag' and the medians shown in the plots always include all time lags. Each plot states how many time lags are not shown. Leave empty to plot all time lags.

references.note: Kranstauber B, Safi K, Scharf AK (2024). move2: R package for processing movement data. Methods in Ecology and Evolution. doi:10.1111/2041-210X.14383
